title: Post-Rajmahal power vacuum deepens
detail: After Daud Khan Karrani's defeat, Mughal authority advanced but did not fully control Bengal's riverine east.

title: Bhati resistance consolidates under Isa Khan
detail: Regional chiefs in Bhati organized defense through forts, flotillas, and tactical alliances often grouped under the Baro-Bhuyans label.

title: Confederate resistance reaches peak visibility
detail: By around 1599, Baro-Bhuyans resistance remained the strongest local barrier to full Mughal consolidation in Bengal.

title: Mughal consolidation overtakes regional bloc
detail: After Isa Khan's era, fractured coordination among successors made confederate resistance less durable against Mughal provincial integration.
